slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice
items: A sudden sharp pain or pop

caption:
Toto does fifty calf raises a day, but they're fast, half-height and on autopilot.

A few small changes make them far more useful: one second up, a short pause, three seconds down. Rise all the way through the big-toe side, and do both straight-knee and bent-knee versions.

When slow single-leg sets of 15 to 20 feel easy, add a step for extra range or hold a dumbbell, building a little each week.

A sudden pop, trouble rising onto your toes or unexplained calf swelling deserve an assessment rather than more reps. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can tailor a calf program to your sport. Book online via the link in bio 🏃
